# spaceman attachment

A space's attachments: upload, show and download (--space).

Aliases: `attachments`.

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`spaceman attachment download`](#spaceman-attachment-download) | Download an attachment's content to a file |
| [`spaceman attachment get`](#spaceman-attachment-get) | Attachment metadata |
| [`spaceman attachment upload`](#spaceman-attachment-upload) | Upload a file; reference the returned uri from an inbox item or a message |

## spaceman attachment download

Download an attachment's content to a file.

Attachments are untrusted content: they are written to a file (mode 0600), never to the terminal.

```sh
spaceman attachment download <attachment> [flags]
```

API: `get-attachment` ([HTTP API](../api)).

Raw route: `GET /spaces/{space_id}/attachments/{attachment_id}/content` (outside the OpenAPI document, same authentication; see the [HTTP API](../api)).

Example:

```sh
spaceman attachment download --space payments att_01… --out ./screenshot.png
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--force` | bool |  | replace an existing file |
| `--out` | string |  | file to write (mode 0600; - writes to standard output when it is not a terminal; required) |
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |

## spaceman attachment upload

Upload a file; reference the returned uri from an inbox item or a message.

Uploads FILE (- reads standard input) as a multipart form. Unreferenced uploads are removed after 24 hours.

```sh
spaceman attachment upload <file> [flags]
```

API: `upload-attachment` ([HTTP API](../api)).

Example:

```sh
spaceman attachment upload --space payments ./screenshot.png
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--idempotency-key` | string |  | Idempotency-Key to send (default: a fresh random key); reuse it to retry this create safely |
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |
